messages:
mira: Quick note: spotted inconsistency between ruby and elixir SDKs for auth header precedence. Ruby picks ENV token over provided api_key in initializer; elixir does the opposite. Caused confusion in the sampleapp onboarding flow.

oleg: Yikes. That'll bite users who set REDWOOD_API_KEY in env and expect test tokens to be used for local runs. Where did this divergence come from?

jen: I think ruby historically used ENV-first to help ephemeral dev tokens, while elixir authors preferred explicit param precedence. Both reasonable but we should standardize. Opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-standards/issues/78

mira: For immediate fix I made a tiny PR in ruby-sdk to change to explicit-param-first and added a note in sampleapp README. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/4233

ci-bot: GitHub Actions: ruby-ci (PR #4233) 1 checks started: lint / unit / integration.

oleg: Can we instead make precedence configurable so integrators can pick their preferred behavior? Maybe REDWOOD_AUTH_PRECEDENCE (env|param)?

jen: Configurable is flexible but adds surface area. I'd prefer we standardize first (param wins), then later expose opt-in env behavior if customers ask. Keep sampleapp consistent across SDKs.

mira: Agree with standardize-first. I updated the sampleapp to show both approaches (explicit param recommended). Also added a tiny test asserting precedence.

sam: Left a small comment on PR: mention the change in UPGRADE.md because some CI setups rely on env-overrides. Also add a short blurb in onboarding docs.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions: ruby-ci (PR #4233) unit failed on macos-latest: flakey test 'test_auth_header_env_fallback' assertion mismatch. Trace: test/auth_test.rb:24

mira: Reproduced flake locally. The test used ENV.assign directly which leaks across threads in our parallel suite. Will refactor to reliable env helper that isolates env updates.

oleg: Thanks. After tests green we should coordinate a small cross-SDK note so elixir/ruby match. I'll ping the elixir maintainer to confirm.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions: ruby-ci (PR #4233) All checks passed on branch 'param-precedence', ready for merge.

jen: Nice work. Once merged please bump the sampleapp quickstart and push a small patch release (0.11.1) since this is developer-facing change.

mira: Will merge and request a patch release. Also added console docs note and a short entry in the SDK parity checklist.

sam: Quick follow-up: let's add a short integration smoke e2e in sampleapp that runs onboarding script with an env override and with explicit param to ensure parity remains. Low cost but catches regressions.

mira: Adding that test now. Thanks all.
